description: This file defines the CategoriesController class, responsible for handling HTTP API requests related to categories in an e-commerce backend. It includes methods for retrieving all categories and a specific category by ID, utilizing Entity Framework for data access.

classes.name: CategoriesController
classes.description: API controller for category-related endpoints, providing methods to retrieve category data from the database.

methods.name: GetCategories
methods.description: Handles GET requests to retrieve all categories from the database asynchronously.

methods.name: GetCategory
methods.description: Handles GET requests with an ID parameter to retrieve a specific category; returns 404 if not found.
